data.description:
## Description

**What**: Set BRIDGE_ENV_ID as a non-empty GitHub repo variable, add fail-loud workflow preconditions in both bridges, and harden filter_bridge_events to skip filter when bridge_env_id is empty (back-compat for existing pre-migration events).

**Why**: This story is the sequencing prerequisite for S1 (cursor). Without filter_bridge_events back-compat, the cursor in S1 will walk past every pre-existing event with env_id empty (every locally-authored event currently in the tracker) and they will be permanently filtered as bridge-origin echoes — silently re-creating the chronic-drop symptom.

**Scope**:
- IN: BRIDGE_ENV_ID repo variable provisioning (gh variable set), outbound-bridge.yml + inbound-bridge.yml fail-loud preconditions matching ACLI_VERSION precondition pattern, filter_bridge_events back-compat path, one-shot migration BRIDGE_ALERT
- OUT: any cursor/checkpoint logic (S1), data-migration of historical env_id-empty events in the tracker

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, the BRIDGE_ENV_ID repo variable is set to a non-empty UUID and visible in `gh variable list` ← Satisfies: "BRIDGE_ENV_ID is set as a non-empty repository variable, both outbound-bridge.yml and inbound-bridge.yml fail fast (precondition check) when the variable is empty"
- When this story is complete, both outbound-bridge.yml and inbound-bridge.yml fail at the precondition step with a non-zero exit and a diagnostic message when BRIDGE_ENV_ID is empty ← Satisfies: same SC
- When this story is complete, filter_bridge_events skips filtering entirely when bridge_env_id is empty (back-compat pass-through), unit-tested with bridge_env_id="" and a mix of env_id="" and env_id="real-uuid" events ← Satisfies: same SC
- When this story is complete, on the first run after BRIDGE_ENV_ID transitions from unset/empty to set, a one-shot migration BRIDGE_ALERT is emitted documenting that pre-migration events are not retroactively replayed ← Satisfies: implicit migration-safety invariant from scrutiny

## Considerations

- [Reliability] BRIDGE_ENV_ID precondition pattern must match the ACLI_VERSION/ACLI_SHA256 fail-loud pattern already in outbound-bridge.yml lines 69-77 (codebase-alignment).
- [Testing] The filter_bridge_events unit test must include the empty bridge_env_id case explicitly — pre-existing tests pass with non-empty env_id only.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As an operator, BRIDGE_ENV_ID is set and the bridge fails fast when it's empty, with filter back-compat for pre-migration events
